title: AX-52
extract:
The AX-52 is a  Scaldra assault rifle repurposed by Arthur during the year 1999. Gains increased Ammo Efficiency when hip-firing or Critical Chance on headshots while aiming.

Characteristics
This weapon deals pure  Puncture damage.
Gains a bonus when firing with or without zoom:
When hip-firing, the weapon has +60% ammo efficiency.
When aiming, headshots have +400% critical chance.
Critical chance bonus is additive to mods like  Point Strike.
Can use the AX-52-exclusive  Biotic Rounds mod.
Two innate  polarities.
Advantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average crit chance (26.00%)
Above average burst DPS (545.6)
Very high ammo pickup (80)
Very high accuracy (0.50° to 1.00°)
Above average reload speed (2.00 s)
High ammo max (540)
High fire rate (10.00 attacks/sec)
High crit multiplier (2.40x)
Disadvantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Low damage per shot (54.56)
Below average total damage (40)
Below average status chance (18.00%)
Low disposition (●●○○○ (0.85x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
AX-52's blueprint can be purchased from Amir of  The Hex in the Höllvania Central Mall for  30,000 at Rank 4 - Hot & Fresh, requiring completion of The Hex to access.

History
A built AX-52 was acquired by watching TennoCon 2024 on WARFRAME's Twitch with a Twitch-linked account for 30 consecutive minutes, between 11:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. ET, on July 20th, 2024. The drop included a free weapon slot and pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Notes
The headshot critical chance increase while aiming is additive with  Primary Acuity.

Trivia
The AX-52 seems to be inspired by the Kalashnikov rifle, a family of assault rifles that includes the AK-47 and the AK-74.
The "AX" portion of the name may be an interpretation of AKS, a variant of the AK-74 that has a folding stock.
The "52" is derived from subtracting 47 from 99 (in reference to 1999).
Notably, despite the name referencing the original 1947 rifle, the lower receiver resembles the stamped design used on later iterations upon the design, most notably the AKM.
Whether this is an intentional homage or simply an artistic choice is unclear, as this is a common mistake, especially in the realm of action films and video games from the time being harkened back to.
Interestingly, this detail is also present on the Counter Strike depiction of the Kalashnikov that the AX-52 borrows the recoil pattern from.
AX-52 first appeared in TennoCon 2023's Whispers in the Walls gameplay teaser. Upon the quest's formal introduction in Update 35.0 (2023-12-13), the weapon is listed as "????". The quest AX-52 also had a magazine size of 30 instead of 40, and an ammo max of 500 instead of 540.
An AX-52 can be found in one of the rooms of the Netracells.
The weapon has a non-static model, with a reciprocating charging handle.
The fire selector is not static. It will change to the "safe" position when holstered.
Both "AwTOhH" (Auto) and "SEhMAyeH" (Semi) options are marked on the weapon in Höllvanian, though the latter cannot be selected.
The AX-52 appears to have the same recoil pattern, albeit less pronounced, as the AK-47 from Counter-Strike.

Bugs
The name is inconsistently displayed as either Ax-52 or AX-52.
